items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Rob is identified as [SPEAKER_04] addressing the interviewee ('That's cool enough, Rob.' is likely a mislabeling or the interviewer speaking to the interviewee, but regardless, there is no narrative content from the interviewee describing a relationship with Rob).

ctx.x: Well, you see them dying, they wouldn't do like y'all do or not. They didn't call him for like y'all do or not.

That's the fellas... I was trying to definitely do for my mom, but I don't know. That's close enough. That's all right. That's cool enough, Rob. Yeah. I got to 1947 because I got to own me. And now I got to own me in September. I'm going to... I'm going to...
Yeah, I just wondered about how old he was and what period he played in then. He played with Celestan and Chris...
